visualQa.scope: seven true-60-Hz reactions, 14 true-60-Hz reaction bridges and three true-60-Hz active idle films
visualQa.note: Every reaction and reaction bridge uses distinct 16/17 ms RIFF frames at 60 Hz. Reactions analytically sample the authored pivot curve; bridges retain one source-only/target-only lineage with no composite anatomy.

pack: BLACKSITE neutral SWAT penguin operator v20 motion pack
lighting: neutral warm-white bunker/studio only; no authored cyan, blue or red rim lighting

idleVariants.source: registered neutral-v2 master with planted-foot procedural patrol/breath motion
idleVariants.motionTruth: 60 distinct active frames from adjacent accepted-frame premultiplied-alpha temporal interpolation; no distant-pose composite
idleVariants.timingMode: variable ANMF macro timing with a true 60 Hz active motion window
idleVariants.transitionGate: immediate inside either neutral hold window; otherwise queue to the next safe window
idleVariants.retimingSource: source/idle-60hz-v4/idle-accepted-25f.webp; adjacent accepted-frame premultiplied-alpha temporal interpolation only
idleVariants.coloredLightGuard: PASS; no colored-light cluster; isolated WebP outliers and natural orange/red-hue pixels remain below thresholds
